answer: Require each identity to pass a randomized liveness check bound to one unique human body: the operator recites a generated sonnet on camera while motion and depth are verified, and the resulting one-way template is deduplicated network-wide, like a jade seal belonging to only one person. One body can never back two identities, and the check cannot be shared, outsourced, or run in parallel, so a canyon of cost separates one real person from a thousand fake accounts: every extra identity needs another living person before a camera, a cost that grows linearly and cannot be amortized by compute.
